0022600150.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, unbeaten at 5-0 and riding a five-game win streak, host the winless Sacramento Kings (0-5, five straight losses) in the sixth game of Memphis's season. Memphis, 1-0 at home and 4-0 on the road, sits 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, while Sacramento is 5th in the Pacific, four games back, and 15th in the West. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle, day-to-day, game-time decision), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Grizzlies lead this season's series 1-0 after winning 123-112 in Sacramento on October 25, and they won last season's series 3-1.
